nearest_sources.title: ForAug: Mitigating Biases in Image Classification via Controlled Image Compositions
nearest_sources.coverage: sections3.1-3.2, background-choice analysis, AppendixA.4; pinned fornet.py constructor and recombine code
nearest_sources.already_known: Foreground/background independence, marginal-versus-joint distinction, foreground scale and background choice diagnostics already explicit. Both input ratios enter mean/range scaling.
nearest_sources.limited_difference: Our finite-metadata conditional source-dependence measurement and independent-ratio control matching P(Y,T) were not located in these sections; no claim ForAug globally fails or this is a new independence theorem.

nearest_sources.already_known: Independent attribute/source-class-balanced background sampling and extra foreground transforms are established.
nearest_sources.limited_difference: Read algorithm samples background independently, rather than the tested two-ratio scale control; no equivalent conditional-source audit located in read sections.

nearest_sources.title: Out-of-Domain Robustness via Targeted Augmentations
nearest_sources.coverage: SameY/all-background methods, habitat preservation ablation, AppendixB.1
nearest_sources.already_known: Some background relationships encode useful habitat; removing every correlation can harm OOD performance.
nearest_sources.limited_difference: Explicit label/habitat conditioned sampling differs from two-ratio scalar coupling. Our information signal alone cannot establish harm.

novelty_verdict: Within this explicitly bounded read, no equivalent experiment with the same two-ratio target scalar and matched P(Y,T)/background control was located. This permits an exploratory candidate under the user criterion; it does not certify originality or publication potential.
limitations: R means published ratio parameter consumed by pinned loader; pilot language mask area must not be read as proven nontransparent-pixel fraction. Loader doc describes foreground-image area ignoring alpha.
T is pre-alpha/pre-crop requested target scale, not measured final visible object area.
C is removed-object source class, not human-verified scene category or a recovered visual feature.
No composites, classifier training, real OOD performance or semantic causal intervention tested.
Independence and collider facts are known; the code-scalar signal is small.
Follow-up hypothesis arose during exploratory reading; local pre-run threshold locking is not external registration or a globally selection-adjusted confirmatory study.
Control zero and matched marginals follow from its construction, not a trained model improvement.
